name: NINA: The Wedding of Shadows
detailed_description:
NINA: The Wedding of Shadows is an atmospheric horror-exploration game for 1 to 5 players. In the shadow of a forgotten vow, withered flowers, and an endless ceremony, you step into an abandoned manor. There is no escape. Unless you break the ritual, you will remain here forever.

Communication, courage, and awareness are your only weapons for survival. Every clue lost in the dark pulls you deeper into a greater mystery. With each step, the scream of someone lost echoes beside you. As time runs out, true horror lies in moving together—or not at all.

A vow once made with love now transforms into a dark ritual within the abandoned manor. A wedding left unfinished and a ceremony left incomplete trigger a curse that will last forever.

WHEN PROMISES DECAY

  • Promises echo through dust-covered halls.

  • Her name is no longer spoken—only whispered.

  • The altar stands, waiting, as if time never moved on.

  • You weren’t invited, but something was expecting you

Faded flowers carry the marks of the past and the painful memories of a lost love. In this forsaken place, every clue is a haunting echo of a love once lived.

WHISPERS OF THE BRIDE

  • Beauty fades, but what it hides still lingers.

  • Petals crumble where footsteps dare not go.

ENDLESS CEREMONY

The manor does not welcome you as a guest, but as a sacrifice. There is no escape. If the ritual is not broken, you will remain here forever, trapped in an eternal ceremony.

ECHOES OF FEAR

With every step, the scream of someone lost echoes in your ears. Moving forward alone in the dark will test you physically and mentally. Every clue lost in the shadows draws you deeper into an even greater terror.

Will you walk away… or take part in a story that refuses to end?

...

Warning

This game contains intense visual and audio effects, including flashing lights and sudden loud noises. It may not be suitable for players with photosensitive epilepsy or those sensitive to jump scares.

Player discretion is strongly advised.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 - 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel i5 or New-Gen i3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

  • Processor: Intel i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
